references.text: Moses calls Israel to hear the statutes and laws that he teaches them, so that they may follow them.
The commandments, statutes, and laws that the Lord has commanded Moses to teach the people.
Exhortation to keep the commandments, statutes, and laws that the Lord gives.
Introduction to the specific statutes and laws that Israel must keep in the promised land.
The Lord commands Israel to keep the statutes and laws with all their heart and all their soul.
Command to keep all of the Lord's statutes and laws.
Joshua is exhorted to keep the entire law that Moses gave, and not turn from it.
The psalmist's desire to carefully keep the Lord's statutes.
The prophecy that the people will walk according to the Lord's laws and keep his statutes.
